overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: councilors separately endorsed an outside letter to the Governor without a quorum communicating, so no deliberation occurred; the related notice allegation was declined.

allegations.summary: Council allegedly deliberated outside a posted meeting about a letter to the Governor on the state's emergency shelter policy, after members individually endorsed it.
allegations.key_passage: Because communication of each Councilor’s endorsement was made independently and was not between or among a quorum of the Council, it did not constitute deliberation under the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Council failed to post notice of a meeting held to discuss the letter to the Governor.
allegations.key_passage: we decline to review that allegation in light of our conclusion that the Council did not deliberate about the Letter

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
